title: Note
description: Append a progress-analysis note to the session timeline. Use after any non-trivial observation so it is not lost across turns. Each note captures what you found, what you plan next, and the evidence backing the finding.

found.description: 1-3 sentence summary of what you just learned. Anchor to specific pages when possible.

plan.description: What you intend to do next (which page to read, which query to search, etc.).

evidence.description: Supporting evidence entries. Each ties a claim to a page.

source.description: Page reference string, e.g. 'Page 5' or 'Page 5, Revenue table'.

filename.description: Only for type='image': the image filename from a figure ref.

side_effect_policy.description: Optional override for what happens after the note is saved. 'auto' uses the harness defaults (archive earlier Read outputs if memory is enabled, and write tree page_findings if tree-annotate is enabled). Use 'save_note_only' for checkpoints you don't want to trigger archive/enrich; use the others to force a specific side effect.
